title: Word Error Rate (WER)
prompt: Why is **Word Error Rate (WER)** ($\frac{S + D + I}{N}$) often a flawed metric for domain-specific ASR (e.g., financial earnings calls, medical dictation, or code-switched multilingual speech where a single misrecognized ticker symbol or dosage number ruins the transcript while common filler words dominate WER)?
